ci(android): run Quick Check and the test matrix on ubuntu-latest

Quick Check requested ubuntu-latest-4-cores and the test matrix
ubuntu-latest-8-cores. Those are larger-runner labels that are not
provisioned for this repo, so the jobs sat queued (the first run hung for
24h before failing) and everything that needs them never started.
